bagPolicy.summary: CMA Fest nightly concerts at Nissan Stadium allow clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" and small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5".
allowed: Clear bags of any style up to 12" x 12" x 6"
prohibited: Non-clear bags larger than 4.5" x 6.5", even inside a clear bag
bagPolicy.note: This is the Nissan Stadium clear bag policy, which applies to all stadium events. Non-clear bags are still inspected. Paid lockers for oversized bags are outside Gates 3 and 9. CMA allows medical equipment after inspection.

parking.note: Festival organizers encourage the use of rideshare, SpotHero, or public parking options. Reserve parking in advance through SpotHero for convenience and affordability.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by CMA Fest. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: The CMA Fest in Nashville offers a variety of food and drink options, featuring local and regional cuisine. Attendees can enjoy a range of culinary delights from numerous vendors, with special offerings that highlight the vibrant food scene of Nashville.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The ADA Shuttle picks up at every shuttle stop inside the festival footprint. Call (888) 825-7712 to request it, from 9:30AM to 1:00AM each day of CMA Fest.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in CMA Fest's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: All CMA Fest passes and tickets are mobile. Bring your phone with the CMA Connect app downloaded and your tickets ready.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at CMA Fest. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
